map.完全期望寿命把当年内存活片段也计入（连续化），比离散取整期望长约 0.5 岁；精: Complete life expectancy also counts the within-year survival segment (continuous), running about 0.5 year longer than the discrete curtate; actuarial reserves and annuity pricing must use the complete expectancy for precision.
